20 Things I've Learned as a Systems (Over) Thinker
...an illustrated book for adult over-thinkers

1/20: Take care of yourself. Your brain is working overtime—all the time. Practice “radical” recovery.

full post: https://www.viktorcessan.com/20-systems-over-thinker-tips/ ty: @viktorcessan

2/20: You may spend a lot longer thinking about things than most people. Pace your delivery.

full post: https://www.viktorcessan.com/20-systems-over-thinker-tips/ ty: @viktorcessan

3/20: If you go deep first, and then simplify…keep in mind that you don’t need to show all of your work.

full post: https://www.viktorcessan.com/20-systems-over-thinker-tips/ ty: @viktorcessan

4/20: Your default description of (almost) any problem will be too threatening/overwhelming.

full post: https://www.viktorcessan.com/20-systems-over-thinker-tips/ ty: @viktorcessan

5/20: Do your deepest thinking with co-conspirators (not the people you’re trying to influence).

full post: https://www.viktorcessan.com/20-systems-over-thinker-tips/ ty: @viktorcessan

6/20: Informal influence is often not formally recognized. Prepare mentally for this.

full post: https://www.viktorcessan.com/20-systems-over-thinker-tips/ ty: @viktorcessan

7/20: The people you’re trying to influence spend 98% of their day overwhelmed by business as usual.

full post: https://www.viktorcessan.com/20-systems-over-thinker-tips/ ty: @viktorcessan

8/20: Remember to also do the job you were hired to do (if you don’t you’ll be easier to discount).

full post: https://www.viktorcessan.com/20-systems-over-thinker-tips/ ty: @viktorcessan

9/20: Seek “quick wins”, but know that most meaningful things will take a while.

full post: https://www.viktorcessan.com/20-systems-over-thinker-tips/ ty: @viktorcessan

10/20: Some things take ages to materialize. It is discontinuous, not continuous.

full post: https://www.viktorcessan.com/20-systems-over-thinker-tips/ ty: @viktorcessan

11/20: Make sure to celebrate your wins. They will be few and far between, so savor the moment.

full post: https://www.viktorcessan.com/20-systems-over-thinker-tips/ ty: @viktorcessan

12/20: The people who support you in private may not be able to support you in public. Accept that.

full post: https://www.viktorcessan.com/20-systems-over-thinker-tips/ ty: @viktorcessan

13/20: Hack existing power structures—it’s much easier than trying to change them.

full post: https://www.viktorcessan.com/20-systems-over-thinker-tips/ ty: @viktorcessan

14/20: Consider becoming a formal leader. It’s harder in many ways, but you’ll have more leverage. What’s stopping you?

full post: https://www.viktorcessan.com/20-systems-over-thinker-tips/ ty: @viktorcessan

15/20: In lieu of being a formal leader, make sure to partner with people who actually “own” the area of change.

full post: https://www.viktorcessan.com/20-systems-over-thinker-tips/ ty: @viktorcessan

16/20: Watch out for imposing your worldview on people. Have you asked about what people care about?

full post: https://www.viktorcessan.com/20-systems-over-thinker-tips/ ty: @viktorcessan

17/20: You’ll need a support network. And not just a venting network. Real support.

full post: https://www.viktorcessan.com/20-systems-over-thinker-tips/ ty: @viktorcessan

18/20: “Know when to fold ‘em”. Listen to Kenny Rogers The Gambler. Leave on your own terms.

full post: https://www.viktorcessan.com/20-systems-over-thinker-tips/ ty: @viktorcessan

19/20: Don’t confuse being able to sense/see system dynamics, with being about to “control” them. You can’t.

full post: https://www.viktorcessan.com/20-systems-over-thinker-tips/ ty: @viktorcessan

20/20: Grapple with your demons, and make sure not to wrap up too much of your identity in change.

full post: https://www.viktorcessan.com/20-systems-over-thinker-tips/ ty: @viktorcessan

Thank you so much @viktorcessan for such a wonderful gift. It means so much! I really value your friendship.

Again...the link: https://www.viktorcessan.com/20-systems-over-thinker-tips/ ty: @viktorcessan
